# 
  Ubuntuverse Institute Releases $3 Trillion Corporate Advocacy PlayBook for Africa

Ubuntuverse Institute Releases $3 Trillion Corporate Advocacy PlayBook for Africa
=================================================================================

News Provided By

[Ubuntuverse Institute](https://www.einpresswire.com/sources/u658132)

April 22, 2026, 21:59 GMT

[![Ubuntuverse Institute quote card: the biggest barrier to Africa's clean energy investment is the absence of coordinated corporate voice](https://img.einpresswire.com/medium/1095827/quote-card-this-is-why-camps.png)](https://img.einpresswire.com/large/1095827/quote-card-this-is-why-camps.png#1491x616)

The biggest barrier is not technical or financial — it is the absence of coordinated corporate voice. — Expert III, Deep-Dive Interview.

[![Ten PlayBook Highlights infographic summarising Africa's $3 trillion clean energy opportunity, 10x growth potential, 75 per cent private capital imperative, and 250 GW African Union renewable target](https://img.einpresswire.com/medium/1095829/the-ten-playbook-highlights.jpeg)](https://img.einpresswire.com/large/1095829/the-ten-playbook-highlights.png#1254x1254)

The Ten PlayBook Highlights: Africa's $3 trillion clean-energy opportunity, 10× growth potential, 75 per cent private-sector imperative, 250 GW AU target, jobs, minerals, and the cost of inaction.

[![Headshot of Prof. Andani Thakhathi, Executive Managing Director of the Ubuntuverse Institute](https://img.einpresswire.com/medium/1095830/dr-andani-thakhathi.jpeg)](https://img.einpresswire.com/large/1095830/dr-andani-thakhathi.png#1036x1036)

Dr. Andani Thakhathi, Andani Thakhathi, Executive Managing Director, Ubuntuverse Institute

[![Infographic of practitioner voices from the PlayBook's deep-dive interviews, citing corporate speed, mid-level leadership influence, and Africa's 25 per cent central bank rates](https://img.einpresswire.com/medium/1095831/practitioner-voices-deep-dive.png)](https://img.einpresswire.com/large/1095831/practitioner-voices-deep-dive.png#1302x666)

Practitioner voices from the PlayBook's deep-dive interview programme, converged around shared motifs on corporate speed, mid-level leadership, and Africa's cost-of-capital disadvantage.

[![Ubuntuverse Institute logo — gold calabash emblem with Universal Dignity tagline](https://img.einpresswire.com/medium/1095832/ubuntuverse-institute-logo.png)](https://img.einpresswire.com/large/1095832/ubuntuverse-institute-logo.png#1080x1080)

Ubuntuverse Institute — Universal Dignity.

_145-page PlayBook shows how corporate advocacy can unlock Africa’s $3 trillion clean energy opportunity and close the 75 per cent private capital gap._

**A clean-industrialised Africa is inseparable from the global just energy transition. This is not a moral appeal — it is a systems reality, and a decision document for corporate actors.”**

— Prof. Andani Thakhathi, Executive Managing Director, Ubuntuverse Institute

PRETORIA, GAUTENG, SOUTH AFRICA, April 22, 2026 /[EINPresswire.com](https://www.einpresswire.com/)
/ -- The [Ubuntuverse Institute](https://ubuntuversal.org/)
 (NPC), an independent South African research institute founded in 2012, today released [The $3 Trillion Corporate Advocacy PlayBook](https://ubuntuversal.org/the-playbook/)
: Africa’s 10x CAMPs Accelerating Just Clean Energy’s Green Industrialisation. The [145-page PlayBook](https://ubuntuversal.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/3-Trillion-PlayBook-Corporate-Green-Industrialisation.pdf)
 is the Institute’s flagship research output of 2026 and is now available in full at [https://ubuntuversal.org/the-playbook/](https://ubuntuversal.org/the-playbook/)
. It arrives at a moment when the African Union’s 250 GW renewable capacity target for 2030 and the continent’s Nationally Determined Contributions remain substantially under-financed, and when the private sector’s role in closing that gap has become a decisive strategic question.  
  
The $3 Trillion Corporate Advocacy PlayBook frames Africa’s clean industrial investment opportunity at approximately three trillion US dollars through 2030 and beyond, of which roughly 75 per cent, or 2.25 trillion US dollars, must be mobilised from private capital rather than public finance. Its core proposition is that the barriers blocking this investment are not primarily technical or financial, but institutional, relational, and political. Trust deficits, coordination failures, and incentive misalignments obstruct corporate resources more than technology costs. The publication presents a structured response: the systematic deployment of Corporate Advocacy Mobilisation Pioneers, or CAMPs, operating across a set of Iconic Renewable Energy Zones identified in the text.  
  
The evidence base underpinning the PlayBook is drawn from the Institute’s triangulated 3D research architecture, combining a structured desk review, deep-dive interviews with 15 senior field practitioners, and a facilitated dialogue workshop with sector leaders. Over 200 institutional sources are cited, including data sets from the International Energy Agency, IRENA, the African Development Bank, the African Union, and BloombergNEF. The 3D methodology is designed to produce evidence-grounded, field-tested outputs rather than desk-only analysis, and every headline figure in the PlayBook is traceable to an institutional source.  
  
"A clean-industrialised Africa is inseparable from the global just energy transition," said Prof. Andani Thakhathi, Executive Managing Director, Ubuntuverse Institute (NPC). "This PlayBook is not a moral appeal. It is a systems reality, and a decision document for corporate actors who understand that waiting is the most expensive option available to them."  
  
The PlayBook reframes Africa as an actor in the global transition rather than a recipient of it. Africa holds approximately 30 per cent of the world’s critical minerals and receives more solar radiation than any other continent, yet captures less than three per cent of global renewable energy investment. The continent is also home to approximately 600 million people without reliable electricity access. The publication identifies five priority sectors -- clean technology manufacturing, renewable energy development, transition minerals and mining, steel, and agriculture and agri-processing -- and seven repeatable strategic manoeuvres through which CAMPs can shift corporate engagement from alignment talk to execution-enabling mobilisation. Targeted green industrialisation, the PlayBook argues, can compress Africa’s development timeline from 50 to 100 years down to 20 to 40 years, while scaling renewable energy employment from 0.3 million jobs toward 8 million.  
  
The full 145-page PlayBook is available for download at [https://ubuntuversal.org/the-playbook/](https://ubuntuversal.org/the-playbook/)
. Corporate leaders, policymakers, development finance institutions, and civil society partners across Africa’s 54 nations and beyond are invited to engage with the framework.  
  
The Ubuntuverse Institute dedicates this first public release to the memory of its co-founder, Prof. Dovhani Reckson Thakhathi, 1959 to 2024, whose scholarship on African development shaped the intellectual foundation on which this publication rests.  
  
About the Ubuntuverse Institute  
  
The Ubuntuverse Institute (NPC) is an independent South African non-profit research institute founded in 2012, advancing evidence-based insight for a just, clean, and green energy transition in Africa and beyond. Positioned as a breath of fresh air in a fragmented and polarised ecosystem demystifying misinformation, the Institute produces field-defining research, convenes cross-sector dialogue, and builds the intellectual infrastructure required for corporate, policy, and community actors to move from alignment to execution. Learn more at [https://ubuntuversal.org](https://ubuntuversal.org/)
 and [https://www.linkedin.com/company/ubuntuversal/](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ubuntuversal/)
.

Prof. Andani Thakhathi  
Ubuntuverse Institute

**Quick Help Guide**  
Find answers to the most common questions:

Editing

Help! I’ve found a typo! No problem. If the **release has already been issued**, we can edit it. The edits will show on versions within the distribution we control. Just send us an email through the contact form below indicating the release and the changes needed. We are happy to help you.

If the **release has not yet been distributed** and is pending, all you need to do is go to the [My Press Releases page](https://www.einpresswire.com/press-releases/)
 and revert it to a draft. You may then make your edits and resubmit the release to our editorial department.

Images

Is there a problem with an image? Sometimes you might need to change or delete an image. Stuff happens. Just contact customer service through our form and indicate the release title, the name of the image that needs to be changed/deleted and the name of the new image if needed for replacement. Make sure the new image is in your [image library](https://www.einpresswire.com/press-releases/images/)
.

Reporting

Do you have a question about your distribution reporting? A distribution report is available with each release about 2 hours after it’s distributed. These reports can be found on your [My Press Releases page](https://www.einpresswire.com/press-releases/)
. Reports are available as HTML and PDF.

Retraction

It doesn't happen often, but if you need a release deleted we can take it down from the distribution network we control. Send us an email through the contact form below and include the title of the content.

About EIN Presswire
===================

EIN Presswire - Everyone's Internet News Presswire™ - has quickly become a relied upon service for professional communicators and when organizations need to get their news in front of the media, stakeholders, and the public that goes online looking for news. And EIN Presswire's pricing is incredibly affordable - hundreds, if not thousands of dollars less than other services, and there are many reasons for that - first and foremost, because EIN Presswire owns and maintains its own proprietary distribution technologies.

EIN Presswire is a market disruptor.

The electronic press release distribution industry is decades old. Many of the original brands still use antiquated technologies and distribution methods that no longer work effectively in reaching an organization's key targets. Despite that, their distribution fees are prohibitively expensive, forcing clients to question the value these services provide. We are becoming the new "normal" in news distribution.

Distributed on newswires, syndicated, delivered to newsrooms, to mobile devices, and great for SEO.

EIN Presswire was founded by seasoned industry professionals who had the vision that the future of news delivery is a centralized hub where news from thousands of sources can be filtered into U.S. State and Country Newswires. We consider EIN Presswire one of the most advanced central sources for communication professionals whose time is valuable. EIN Presswire is designed to assist those seeking breaking news and those who have breaking news to share. You can now upload your news directly into the stream of daily breaking news. EIN Presswire's clients are global and diverse, all sharing similar goals - efficiencies, productivity, effectiveness, and value.

Our proprietary distribution footprint reaches millions, and for a fraction of our competitors' cost, we can distribute your messaging. We develop and maintain proprietary distribution channels that reach the places where journalists, corporate decision-makers, state officials, and the public go for critically important news and information.

Press content delivery for the digital age. At EIN Presswire, our mission is really simple: We help the world communicate - we are Everyone's Internet News Presswire™.

How It Works
============

It's as easy as 1-2-3
---------------------

Simply create and upload your releases. Use them when you need to within one year from the date of purchase. Buy more distribution credits when you are ready.

Review Process
--------------

**For all new customers, there is a one-time account verification check that begins when you submit your first release. The verification check may take up to two business days.**

After the check is complete and for all other customers who have already been checked, it generally takes about two hours to review your release prior to distribution. Press releases are reviewed during business hours.

Check out the [Getting Started Guide](https://www.einpresswire.com/guide-pdf/EIN-Presswire-Getting-Started-Guide.pdf)
 for more details.

Reporting
---------

After 2 hours, your distribution report will be available on the My Press Releases page and emailed to you. Please refer to a [sample report](https://www.einpresswire.com/press-releases/representative-report)
.

*   Step 1 - You create a press release and submit it for editorial review.
*   Step 2 - Content moderators review the press release to be sure it meets the [editorial guidelines](https://www.einpresswire.com/editorial-guidelines)
    . They may reach out to you for more information so please keep an eye on your inbox.
*   Step 3 - Your press release goes out for distribution and you will receive your report.
*   All done! Congratulate yourself!

Watch our Video Tutorials
-------------------------

*   [How to upload a press release using EIN Presswire](https://www.einpresswire.com/video-tutorials#release)
    
*   [How to view a distribution report](https://www.einpresswire.com/video-tutorials#report)
    
*   [Understanding the EIN Presswire distribution](https://www.einpresswire.com/video-tutorials#distribution)

Company Ethos
=============

At the heart of our company ethos is a commitment to democratic principles, openness, and inclusiveness. We strive to present fact-based content in our media output and products. In a world rife with misinformation, government propaganda, and "alternative facts," we pride ourselves on being a beacon of accuracy and transparency, ensuring that our audiences receive information rooted in the truth, empowering them to make informed decisions and engage meaningfully with the world around them. Defending the rights and opportunities of minorities and the public good is a fundamental pillar of our identity.

EIN Presswire Editorial Guidelines
==================================

Version dated December 2, 2025.

These Editorial Guidelines ("Guidelines") are incorporated by reference into and shall be governed by Our [General Terms and Conditions](https://www.einpresswire.com/legal/terms)
 \[Ref. 1\] (“Terms”) and any applicable Service Agreements, [Acceptable Use Policy](https://www.einpresswire.com/legal/aup)
 \[Ref. 2\] ("AUP"), [DMCA Policy](https://www.einpresswire.com/legal/dmca)
 \[Ref. 3\], [Privacy Policy](https://www.einpresswire.com/legal/privacy)
 \[Ref. 4\], or other binding Company documents (collectively, "Our Agreements") adopted by Newsmatics Inc. ("Company", "We", "Us", or "Our"). Capitalized terms not defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to them in Our Agreements.

By accessing or using any of Our Services or web sites, You ("You", "Your", or "User") expressly agree to comply with these Guidelines. If You do not agree to be bound by these Guidelines, You are expressly prohibited from using any of Our Services or web sites, and must immediately discontinue all use.

 1\. Quality Content
--------------------

All press releases submitted to EIN Presswire must:

*   Be written in an acceptable [press release format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Press_release)
     \[Ref. 5\].
    
*   Avoid inflammatory language, hyperbole, and unattributed opinion, or invasion of someone’s privacy.
    
*   Be accurate and free of potentially libelous material.
    
*   Clearly identify opinions in quotes or attribute these statements as opinions belonging to the organization, and not state them as fact.
    
*   Cite from a fact-checked news source.
    
*   Contain explicit attribution to an authorized source such as court documents.
    
*   Be free of content intended to harm or exact revenge upon an individual or group.
    
*   Not be threatening, abusive, menacing, offensive, violent, intimidating or otherwise objectionable.
    
*   Not make attempts to incite fear or panic, including but not limited to releases predicting the end of the world or terrorist attacks.
    
*   Not intend to harm or exact revenge upon an individual or group, which is defined as content that is deemed intended to: (i) incite, advocate or express hatred, bigotry, racism or gratuitous violence; (ii) promote personal opinions attacking an individual or group; (iii) maliciously affect a company’s stock; (iv) stalk, defame, defraud, degrade, shame or victimize an individual or group.
    

EIN Presswire will review your press releases before distribution. Attention to the following guidelines will help your press release get through the process quickly.

All press releases must contain a clear, timely and newsworthy angle and be free of advertising hype, direct address, and spam. Press releases should incorporate the following features/qualities:

*   **Newsworthy Content:** Common news angles include timely information about a new product or service, business expansion or recent event, an organizational or a community milestone like an anniversary or award or the issuance of a tip sheet or expert opinion on a topic currently in the news. The news announcement must be clearly stated in the headline.
    
*   **Objective Tone:**  EIN Presswire press releases should be free of hype flags and direct addresses (i.e. “you,” “I,” “we,” etc.) unless used within a quotation from a spokesperson from a company or organization. Direct address is a flag that the content is an advertisement rather than a news release. Similarly, hype flags — exclamation points; hyperbolic product/service claims; descriptions of a product or service as AMAZING, or the use of upper case characters to create emphasis — challenge the credibility of your news announcement.
    
*   **Legally Accurate:** EIN Presswire requires a case number, court of record, complaint number or other sufficient documentation for all press releases referencing legal action or criminal matters.
    
*   **Financial Topics/Cryptocurrency:** Any financial-related topics including but not limited to Cryptocurrency, NFT, etc. must provide full transparency for verification, including contact information and postal address is to be on the website(s) and/or social media pages.
    
*   **Valid Contact Information:** EIN Presswire press releases must contain a valid contact name, phone number, and email address in the contact information.
    
*   **Written Authorization:** In certain cases, such as with network marketing companies, with the use of a stock ticker symbol, or with major corporate announcements such as (but not limited to) those related to M&A, EIN Presswire may require written authorization from a company executive before a press release is approved for distribution. Independent representatives of network marketing companies, MLM or party plan companies must always obtain the express consent of the company’s executive.
    
*   **Standard Length:** EIN Presswire press releases should be between 300 and 800 words. The length of your release directly affects its distribution, and press releases that are overly short or long may have trouble being indexed in search engines.
    
*   **Standard Grammar and Spelling:** EIN Presswire press releases should be free of spelling and grammatical errors. Although jargon and acronyms are commonplace in natural language, make sure to include definitions for industry jargon so the average person can understand as well.
    
*   **Formatting:** EIN Presswire press releases cannot contain HTML tags and other formatting such as non-standard characters, tables or forced line breaks. Releases also should not be written partially or entirely in all capital letters. Before submitting your release, please ensure all links in your release are fully functional. If your website is not available or fully functional at the time of editorial review, you will need to remove the links from your release or wait until the website is in operation to submit.
    
*   **A Clear News Source:** EIN Presswire requires a clear news source to be identified in the headline. The news source is the company or organization that is issuing the release. If your agency, firm or business is distributing on behalf of a client, then the source would be the client’s company or organization’s name. It should also be clear how that company or organization relates to the news announcement.
    
*   **Email Addresses:** EIN Presswire does not recommend the use of email addresses within the body of the press release. If an email address is included, our editorial team will modify the email address to be in this format Name (at) example (dot) com.
    
*   **Accepted File Types:** EIN Presswire only accepts releases containing images with the following extensions: .jpeg, .gif, .png.
    

2\. Excluded Content
--------------------

EIN Presswire does not distribute:

*   **Advertisements**: If your press release is primarily aimed at selling a product or service, then it is an advertisement and not a press release. A good press release informs the media and the general public about a newsworthy topic. If the primary purpose of the document is to sell without any other newsworthy element, then it will be denied publication.
    
*   **False or Misleading Content:** Content that is verifiably untrue or misleading.
    
*   **Academic Writing Services:** EIN Presswire does not publish releases that promote and/or link to academic writing services. This includes essay, dissertation, thesis, application, research, paper, assignment, and/or homework writing services.
    
*   **Sexually Explicit Content:** To ensure the integrity of our service for all, EIN Presswire does not accept content about sexually explicit material or products. Press releases should not contain references or links to explicitly sexual material, illegal material or profane language. Please note that all 18-and-older websites are considered sexually explicit.
    
*   **Link SPAM:** Please limit your link count to 1 per 100 words. This policy is in place to protect the value of the links in a press release and the value of links within the EIN Presswire network.
    
*   **Reprints:** News and feature images, articles, opinion columns, editorials or news stories from other websites or publications, especially if they are copyrighted, are not press releases.
    
*   **Duplicate Content:** A press release can only be distributed once through EIN Presswire. In addition, a significant majority of each press release must be original content. Templated content is not permitted. Using copyrighted content from other sources is a violation of Our Terms.
    
*   **Third-Party Legal Releases:** EIN Presswire only accepts press releases from law firms in which the firm is representing one of the parties in the case. EIN Presswire does not accept press releases regarding legal cases from third-party firms.
    
*   **Potentially Malicious:** EIN Presswire does not distribute content that in our opinion could harm or exact revenge upon an individual or group. This content is defined as anything that may: incite, advocate or express hatred, bigotry, racism or gratuitous violence; promote personal opinions attacking an individual or group; maliciously affect a company’s stock; or stalk, defame, defraud, degrade, shame or victimize an individual or group.
    
*   **Adverse to our Ethos:** EIN Presswire does not distribute content that is contrary to our beliefs in promoting an open and inclusive society. Please refer to the [Company Ethos](https://www.einpresswire.com/company-ethos)
     \[Ref. 6\]. 
    
*   **Written Authorization:** In certain cases, such as with network marketing companies, with the use of a stock ticker symbol, or with major corporate announcements such as (but not limited to) those related to M&A, EIN Presswire may require written authorization from a company executive before a press release is approved for distribution. Independent representatives of network marketing companies, MLM or party plan companies must always obtain the express consent of the company’s executive.
    
*   **Unauthorized Ticker Symbols:**  While we encourage our clients to use any ticker symbols they are authorized to use in their press releases, we will need to receive the proper authorization from the source company for each ticker symbol used.
    
*   **Online Gambling:** EIN Presswire does not publish releases that promote or link to online gambling, fantasy sports, and related sites that utilize a “pay-to-play” model for participation.
    
*   **Payday or Short-Term Loans:** EIN Presswire does not publish releases that promote or link to payday, short-term or other unsecured loan services.
    
*   **Gun Topics:** Press releases promoting the sale of handguns, rifles, shotguns, hunting guns, functioning antique guns, airsoft guns, paintball guns, bb guns, 3D-printed guns and any parts or component, whether finished or unfinished, that's essential to or enhances the functionality of a gun.
    
*   **Online Pharmaceuticals:** EIN Presswire does not accept releases from online pharmacies or websites that sell prescription drugs unless both the website and release explicitly state that a doctor’s prescription is required for purchase. In addition, pharmaceutical sites that are acceptable must be located within the United States or the United Kingdom.
    
*   **Tobacco:** Press releases promoting the sale of tobacco or any products containing tobacco or nicotine, its consumption, or simulate tobacco smoking, e.g. vaping, e-cigarettes, herbal cigarettes.
    
*   **Weight Loss Products:** EIN Presswire does not allow any weight loss products or ingredients.
    
*   **Health Supplements:** EIN Presswire does not allow any health supplement content, irrespective of any claims of legality.
    
*   **Sexual Enhancement Products:** EIN Presswire does not allow press releases that promote sexual enhancement products.
    
*   **Easy Money Schemes:** EIN Presswire does not accept releases that promote make-money-online, work-from-home programs or get-rich-quick schemes.
    
*   **Stock Recommendations:** EIN Presswire does not accept releases that promote stock picks, trading bots, newsletters, alerts, recommendations, advice or reviews. Publicly traded companies may still promote their own news.
    
*   **Forex Trading Platforms:** EIN Presswire does not accept releases that promote the use of Forex trading platforms, Forex trading demo accounts, Leveraged or Funded Forex trading accounts, or AI-based Forex trading tools or bots. Organizations may submit releases that promote news about the Forex industry as a whole.
    
*   **Cloud Mining:** EIN Presswire does not accept releases that promote cloud mining services. 
    
*   **BlackHat SEO Tactics:**  EIN Presswire does not allow releases to promote or link to Black Hat SEO tactics and services. These types of services include, but are not limited to, keyword stuffing, link buying, and selling, link stuffing, over-hyphenated domains, paid social media followers, and reputation management.
    
*   **Viruses, Scripts, and Codes:** EIN Presswire does not accept releases that contain or link to any viruses, scripts, programs, web pages or any code that destroys, alters, or inhibits the operation of any computer systems.
    

3\. Legal News Guidelines
-------------------------

Legal press releases may be accepted if: 

1.  The client is a law firm, or represented by an agency or agent who is clearly identifiable, and the address of the law firm is clearly presented on their website. 
    
2.  The purpose of the release is not to influence public opinion about a particular case or announce a pending filing of a lawsuit. 
    
3.  It includes the case number(s) related to the content.
    

Press releases about legal cases can:

*   Announce the winning of a lawsuit.
    

Press releases about legal cases are not:

*   Announcements of intentions to file a court case against an individual or group.
    
*   Potentially libelous, which is defined as content that falsely depicts or implies a person: (a) has committed a crime or is guilty of illegal activity; (b) lacks mental capacity; (c) has engaged in immoral behavior; (d) has a loathsome disease.
    
*   Interpretations of legal proceedings: (a) all claims about events surrounding a court case need to be attributed to court documents; (b) until a case is decided, events cannot be interpreted, but only detail what court documents allege.
    

4\. Political News Guidelines
-----------------------------

Political press releases should only be accepted if: 

1.  State & National political campaigns should have an email address, a campaign address, and a website and the customer is required to use an email address associated with the campaign website.
    
2.  Sometimes, local races for smaller offices might not have a website or structured campaign operations. In this case, customers should always be identifiable through their social media presence and they should provide their LinkedIn handle.
    
3.  **Releases should not be accusational or negative. They should represent the policies, activities, and goals of the candidate(s).**
    

Press releases about political matters can:

*   Contain fair comment of a political or public figure as long as this content does not cross over into libel territory.
    
*   Express the opinion or official stance of an organization on a public issue or current event, however, opinions must be put into the form of a quote and properly attributed to the organization making the statement. 
    

5\. No Waiver of Company Rights
-------------------------------

The Company’s failure to enforce these Guidelines in any instance shall not constitute a waiver of its right to enforce them in any other instance. No waiver shall be effective unless in writing and executed by an officer of the Company.

6\. Modifications
-----------------

The Company reserves the right to amend or modify these Guidelines at any time in its sole discretion. The current version of these Guidelines will be made available at the footer of Our web sites. All changes are effective immediately upon publication. Your continued use of the Services or web sites following any such changes constitutes Your express acceptance of the modified Guidelines.

7\. Precedence of Terms in Conflicts
------------------------------------

In the event of conflict or inconsistency between the provisions of these Guidelines and Our Terms, the provisions of Our Terms shall take precedence.

8\. Contact and Questions
-------------------------

For questions regarding these Guidelines, or to report any violations thereof, please visit Our [contact page](https://www.einpresswire.com/contact)
 \[Ref. 7\].

Trustpilot Reviews and EIN Presswire's Commitment to Integrity
==============================================================

EIN Presswire has served the global business and media community for over 20 years, delivering high-quality press release distribution services to tens of thousands  of clients across a wide range of industries. Our reputation is built on editorial integrity, transparency, and professionalism.

In light of certain reviews posted on Trustpilot, we believe it is important to clarify the differences between the standards we uphold and how open review platforms operate.

Our Editorial and Client Transparency Standards
-----------------------------------------------

At EIN Presswire, we maintain strict editorial guidelines and expect transparency from all clients. We are not a platform for anonymous opinions, advertorials, or unverified claims. All press releases go through an editorial screening process to ensure they meet our standards for newsworthiness and relevance.

We strive to provide a platform that combats misinformation, not one that enables it.

Rejected Content and Review Retaliation
---------------------------------------

From time to time, online trolls or bad actors attempt to misuse our platform to publish misleading, promotional, or unreliable content. When such submissions are rejected—and accounts are blocked as a result—some individuals respond with 1-star Trustpilot reviews as a form of retaliation.

These reviews are often unverified and misleading, and do not reflect the experience of our legitimate client base. We stand by our editorial team’s decisions and take pride in protecting the integrity of the information distributed through EIN Presswire.

Understanding Trustpilot's Model
--------------------------------

Trustpilot serves as an open review platform. Trustpilot is not legally required to disclose that the reviews posted on its site are unverified. It is not required to identify anonymous reviewers. It does not have to investigate, fact-check, or validate the content of reviews.

As a result, any comment or review posted on Trustpilot about EIN Presswire may be anonymous, unverified, and not reflective of the vast majority of our clients’ experiences.

In contrast, EIN Presswire stands by its commitment to editorial rigor, transparent communication, and professional publishing practices.

Our Record of Service and Integrity
-----------------------------------

Despite occasional hostile reviews from individuals whose submissions we’ve justifiably rejected, EIN Presswire continues to be trusted by businesses, nonprofits, government agencies, and media outlets worldwide. Our track record shows a long-standing dedication to upholding journalistic principles and helping prevent the spread of misinformation.

We encourage our current and future clients to judge our service based on real interactions, the quality of distributed content, and the value we bring to their media outreach efforts.

Press Release Distribution
==========================

EIN Presswire has a distribution footprint that reaches millions, including journalists, businesses, and industry professionals.

*   **Get Syndicated on Major News Sites** - The Associated Press (also called AP and AP Wire), reaching more than half of the world's population; Nexstar, America's largest local television and media company reaching 68% of U.S. household reach; the USA TODAY Network, made up of hundreds of local news outlets reaching 181 million digital readers; Google News; Affinity Group Publications; and more. Your press release will be reprinted on an ever-growing list of highly search engine-visible industry- and country-relevant third-party publisher sites, as well as EIN Presswire's publications and newswires.
*   **Ingested by AI & Machine Learning Systems** - Your press release becomes part of the digital conversation. EIN Presswire content is picked up by AI and machine learning tools used across news aggregators, online assistants, search engines, and analytics platforms. This means your story isn't just distributed—it's discoverable by systems that power smart search, real-time alerts, and content recommendations. It's a smart way to extend your visibility without paying enterprise-level prices.
*   **Immediate Reprints on US T.V. and Radio Station Sites** - Your release will show up on ABC, NBC, FOX, CBS, CW affiliate sites and dozens of radio station sites across the country with more than 150 million monthly unique users.
*   **Hit the Wires** - We are the world-leading online international newswire service. Leveraging our enterprise-level news aggregation, our newswires surface and organize news from every U.S. state and country, providing worldwide proprietary distribution to journalists, editorial rooms, and millions of readers.
*   **Pushed Direct into Leading News Aggregators and Research Tools** - We are a Google News provider and feed our releases into Bloomberg Terminals, MuckRack, Moody's NewsEdge, Naviga and MenaFN.
*   **Get Delivered to Mobile Devices** - Our cutting-edge news apps deliver breaking and topical news directly to users' mobile devices, including relevant press releases from our newswires.
*   **Gain Direct Access to Media & Newsrooms Worldwide** - Our World Media Directory is a comprehensive, preeminent database of human-curated details to editorial desks and journalists. We deliver your press release directly into these newsrooms for maximum exposure.
*   **Go Viral on Social Media** - We allow clients to customize their X titles with hashtags to maximize reach and enable viral opportunities. Easily share your press release across Facebook, LinkedIn, and X.
*   **Leverage SEO Benefits** - We show up organically through dominant SEO positioning, and by hosting your press release, you'll get high-quality backlinks and see your release almost immediately in major search engines.

Get your release syndicated on major news publications, delivered into newsrooms, sent directly to targeted journalists, and ingested by search engines and LLMs.

How We Are Different. Better.
=============================

Your available press release distribution options have changed over the last few years.

There is no need to stay with a single high-priced press release service and an exclusive contract. The world of distribution is simply too big for that. Our clients think in terms of footprints of distribution because no one service will get you in front of everyone you need to reach

EIN Presswire owns and maintains its own proprietary distribution technologies and is building new paths forward. Most traditional news release distribution services rely on third-party vendors to reach the media, and those costs are passed along to the client. Their business model created expensive, yet limited geographic circuits or newslines.

Ideal for businesses large and small, NGOs, non-profits, government, and their agencies.

But the premise of delivering press releases to journalists via "the wire" or even via email in and of itself is no longer valid. Media databases with journalists' email addresses and even beats are most often inaccurate. Even if they're accurate, journalists' email inboxes are more than full -- with hundreds of pitches they can't possibly read through. Promising to reach other key audiences and the public by sending news releases to databases is also a stretch.

The key to any successful communication outreach is to have an organization's news reach the places where they're searched and found. Search engines, syndication on local news publications, and a heavy presence on social media provide a wide net to maximize reach.

Regarding the media, EIN Presswire has created hundreds of geographic media directories publicly available and updated online by the newsroom itself. These media points know about EIN Presswire. When their reporting staff investigates stories looking for breaking news or background material, they search online sources where EIN Presswire has maximum visibility.

Equally important, clients' news is easily found by stakeholders and the public because EIN Presswire not only posts news releases to the most important online sites, social media platforms, and search engines, they're also indexed and commingled with other leading news source material to hundreds of online industry EIN Presswire publications and newswires.

It's very powerful when a newswire service is also a go-to leading publisher of industry news.

No other press release distribution service comes close to what EIN Presswire provides with respect to forward-leaning distribution footprints.

1. About us
-----------

* * *

 About EIN Presswire

EIN Presswire is a market disruptor changing the way you think about press release distribution.

Unlike our competitors, EIN Presswire is also a world-leading newswire service and media directory publisher. Covering every major region in the world, EIN Presswire also feeds news to millions of people. This means greater effectiveness for those who have news to share. Just like you.

Our mission is yours: EFFECTIVENESS AND AFFORDABILITY. We have millions of users.

Why not start reaching them?

* * *

 Is EIN Presswire part of Cision or PR Newswire?

EIN Presswire is not part of Cision/PR Newswire. We are similar to them in that we publish and distribute press releases, but we have our own proprietary and unique distribution platform which we consider superior in various important ways.

The EIN Presswire service is operated by [Newsmatics Inc.](https://www.newsmatics.com/)
 (previously IPD Group, Inc.), an independent privately-held company registered in the United States. Newsmatics was founded in 1995.

* * *

2. Distribution
---------------

* * *

 Why should I use EIN Presswire instead of a competitor?

The answer is simple - return on your investment. With EIN Presswire you can reach millions of people in minutes, and stay visible in search for years to come with market-disrupting pricing.

Unlike our competitors, EIN Presswire has a more diverse proprietary distribution footprint. We reach journalists, businesses, and industry professionals in more innovative and effective ways.

You will have access to distribution into Google News, AP News, the National Law Review, U.S. TV affiliate sites (NBC, ABC, FOX, CBS, CW), Bloomberg Terminals, MuckRack, Crunchbase, world-leading newswires, 3,900+ Affinity Group Publications, and much more. We also own and manage the #1 online EIN World Media Directory through which you can reach journalists around the globe.

Our trifecta of media distribution, newswire placement, and targeted opt-in email coverage is unique in our industry. EIN Presswire provides you with a highly effective service and exceptional reach at just about the lowest pricing you’ll find.

We have millions of users. Why not start reaching them?

* * *

 Who do you distribute to?

EIN Presswire provides a world-leading [press release distribution](https://www.einpresswire.com/distribution)
 platform and proprietary [newswire service](https://www.einnews.com/)
 used by leading journalists and professionals worldwide. We reach millions of people.

*   We distribute through AP News, the National Law Review, 115+ TV and radio stations throughout the United States such as ABC, CBS, NBC, and Fox News, and feed into Bloomberg Terminals, MuckRack, Crunchbase, MENAFN, and many more sites and databases.
*   We are also a Google News publisher. This means your releases will be visible within Google News and distributed via the Google News Alert service.
*   We push our press releases into 3,900+ industry/country/region-focused publications as part of the [Affinity Group Publishing](https://www.affinitygrouppublishing.com/)
     network. These sites provide targeted traffic, host press releases indefinitely, and are highly visible in search. Our distribution provides both short-term and long-term value for your press release.
*   We partner with thousands of local publications around the globe as well as a wide array of industry-specific trade publications, giving you access to more than 25 industry verticals.
*   Our [World Media Directory](https://www.einpresswire.com/world-media-directory/)
     provides you with worldwide reach. It's the #1 online media directory in the world.

Simply put, you have access to distribution points that our competitors can’t reach.

Distribution includes:

*   Major news sites such as AP News, the National Law Review, 3,900+ Affinity Group Publications, etc.
*   115+ US TV sites such as NBC, ABC, CBS, FOX, and CW
*   Google News + Google News Alerts
*   Databases such as Bloomberg Terminals, MuckRack, etc.
*   Search engines (Google, Yahoo, Bing)
*   RSS feeds
*   EIN Newswires
*   EIN World Media Directory (#1 in the world)

* * *

 Can you explain your distribution in more detail? How does it differ from your competitors?

EIN Presswire has a distribution footprint that reaches millions, including journalists, businesses, and industry professionals. Our goal is to provide both immediate impact in the current news cycle, as well as long-term visibility in search engines, to maximize reach and engagement.

*   Get Syndicated on Major News Sites - Including the Associated Press (also called AP and AP Wire), which reaches more than half of the world's population with news, the National Law Review, Nexstar, who is America's largest local television and media company, reaching 68% of U.S. television households, Google News, and so much more. Your press release will be reprinted on an ever-growing list of highly search-engine-visible industry and country-relevant third-party publisher sites, as well as EIN Presswire's publications.
*   Immediate Reprints on US TV and Radio Station Sites - Your release will show up on ABC, NBC, FOX, CBS, CW affiliate sites, and dozens of radio station sites across the country with more than 150 million monthly unique users.
*   Hit the Wires - We are the world-leading online international newswire service. Leveraging our enterprise-level news aggregation, our newswires surface and organize news from every US state and country, providing worldwide proprietary distribution to journalists, editorial rooms, and millions of readers.
*   Pushed Directly into Leading News Aggregators and Research Tools - We are a Google News provider and feed our releases into Bloomberg Terminals, MuckRack, Moody's NewsEdge, Naviga, Crunchbase, and MenaFN.
*   Gain Direct Access to Media & Newsrooms Worldwide - Our World Media Directory is a comprehensive, preeminent database of human-curated contact details for editorial desks and journalists. We deliver your press release directly into these newsrooms for maximum exposure.
*   Leverage SEO Benefits - We show up organically through dominant SEO positioning. By hosting your press release, you'll get high-quality backlinks and see your release almost immediately in major search engines.

* * *

 Will my release be distributed worldwide?

EIN Presswire distributes releases worldwide via AP News, 3,900+ news sites covering every country in the world and dozens of industry verticals, as well as direct contact with journalists using our [World Media Directory](https://www.einpresswire.com/world-media-directory/)
. You’ll get picked up by [TV and radio stations](https://www.einpresswire.com/distribution-2)
 throughout the US, distributed through our [country and industry newswires](https://www.einnews.com/all_countries)
, and fed into news databases such as Bloomberg Terminals, MuckRack, etc. We are also a [Google News](https://news.google.com/)
 publisher - a gateway to reach billions of people.

* * *

 How do I target states in the US? Do you distribute, for example, to Alaska?

EIN Presswire targets your press releases to specific states in the US using the location you specify when [creating a press release](https://www.einpresswire.com/video-tutorials)
. We have [lists of local media](https://www.einpresswire.com/world-media-directory/3/united-states)
 based on each state. We also operate [newswires](https://www.einnews.com/)
 for every U.S. state to help deepen your reach in the market.

EIN Presswire provides targeted distribution based on the country selection. When targeting the United States, you will also receive additional state-specific distribution based on the state listed in your byline.

To target a specific US State with a press release, you will need to select the United States as your country target. Then, list the desired "target" state within the location section of the press release submission form.

* * *

 Do you distribute to the United Kingdom and other countries?

Yes, EIN Presswire distributes worldwide. Our UK media distribution list is [here](https://www.einpresswire.com/world-media-directory/3/united-kingdom)
. We also operate a [UK Newswire](https://www.einnews.com/country/uk)
 and work with local publishers. To see other countries we distribute to, visit our [World Media Directory](https://www.einpresswire.com/world-media-directory/)
 and our [world newswires](https://world.einnews.com/all_countries)
.

* * *

 Will my press release show up in Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg Terminals, and DOW?

We do feed into Bloomberg Terminals, but this will not be enough to meet SEC publicly traded company financial disclosure requirements. To get your news into Yahoo Finance you need to use PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire, or Business Wire. Yahoo Finance is an expensive pay-to-play distribution point and has solid value for publicly traded companies needing to meet financial disclosure requirements. However, for SMBs/SMEs, the associated cost versus impact and engagement is minimal, creating a poor ROI.

* * *

 Does distribution through EIN Presswire guarantee that the media will use my news release?

We guarantee that your releases will be published on the distribution networks that we control and go out through gateway services such as Google News, AP News, and on major network TV and radio websites such as NBC, CBS, Fox, etc., for republishing.

Through the EIN Presswire World Media Directory, we reach journalists and editorial desks throughout the world.

Through EIN Presswire you can increase your:

*   Search engine rank
*   Brand visibility
*   Online presence
*   Company's positive image in the market
*   Positioning as an expert in your industry niche

Most journalists use the same tools that you have available to monitor topics. For example, Google News Alerts are an important resource, and your press release can be available in that source.

* * *

 What are the restrictions with AP News distribution?

AP News does not accept non-English language press releases.

* * *

 What are the limitations of the 115+ US TV station sites?

Most US TV stations such as NBC, ABC, CBS, FOX, and CW, are IP-locked to US IP addresses. This means that if you are located outside of the US, you might not be able to see your release unless using a VPN.

* * *

 Do you accept releases in languages other than English?

EIN Presswire distributes press releases in all languages. Simply target your desired audience when you [create your press release](https://www.einpresswire.com/press-releases/)
.

* * *

 What are the acceptable topics for content?

The section on acceptable and unacceptable content is located in the [Editorial Guidelines](https://www.einpresswire.com/legal/editorial-guidelines)
. Please also see the [General Terms & Conditions](https://www.einpresswire.com/legal/terms)
 for further info.

* * *

 Can we distribute press releases pertaining to legal cases?

Yes, but it depends on whether the release is associated with a law firm or not, as well as the specific topic. For legal cases, we require a law firm email to be listed on the client's EIN Presswire account or some other compelling explanation as to why it can’t be provided. (If the release cannot be distributed, we will issue a refund.)

We require full transparency. You should use a company email address and full contact details. Preferably, you should have your law firm's contact details on the release. We might call them.

Please see Section 3 of the [Editorial Guidelines](https://www.einpresswire.com/legal/editorial-guidelines)
 for more info.

* * *

 Do you offer press release writing services?

Sorry, we don’t, but we do have thousands of good examples from our clients on our website. In addition, we've launched a free AI-powered press release generator. The generator allows professionals like you to save time and money by automatically generating a draft press release in as little as 10 seconds. All you need to provide is a few descriptive keywords. The drafts are generated in the best possible English. Clients can then proofread and modify the text to their liking before posting the press release.

To create a release using the AI-powered press release generator, go to: [https://www.einpresswire.com/ai/press-release-generator](https://www.einpresswire.com/ai/press-release-generator)

* * *

 How does EIN Presswire help my SEO ranking?

EIN Presswire is a great source of quality backlinks and SEO rank improvement. We are a [Google News](https://news.google.com/)
 and AP News source. You’ll have permanent placement on country, state, region, and industry-focused newswires, as well as TV and radio stations in the United States.

You’ll gain additional benefits just by issuing a release through EIN Presswire. You can increase your:

*   Search engine rank
*   Brand visibility
*   Online presence
*   Company’s positive image in the market
*   Positioning as an expert in your industry niche

* * *

 What do your clients say about your press release distribution services?

They love our service! We’re simple and easy to use and offer great value at affordable pricing. See some of our client testimonials [here](https://www.einpresswire.com/testimonials-client-reviews)
.

* * *

 How often should I send a press release?

To optimize your online presence, you should participate in more news cycles. Many of our clients issue a release once a month. This offers them an opportunity to communicate more often with the world and to build high-quality backlinks to their websites. Our [Pro+ Bundle](https://www.einpresswire.com/pricing)
 provides you with 5 press release distribution credits for [one low price](https://www.einpresswire.com/pricing)
. Think of press releases as extended social media posts. You have a headline and small update on any topic, and then attach your company or client boilerplate and contact details. Press releases do not need to be issued only for monumental announcements. They can be used for your ongoing marketing communications.

* * *

 Can I get an RSS feed of my own press releases?

Yes. Go to the [My Press Releases](https://www.einpresswire.com/press-releases/)
 page and look for the RSS icon.

* * *

 How do I share my press release?

We have provided you with links to share. You can find them on the [My Press Releases](https://www.einpresswire.com/press-releases/)
 page. In the Share section, you will find your permalink and links to share your release on social media platforms.

3. Pricing
----------

* * *

 Where do I find your price list?

Please visit our [Pricing and Comparison](https://www.einpresswire.com/pricing)
 page or [Pricing Overview PDF](https://www.einpresswire.com/guide-pdf/EIN-Presswire-Pricing-Overview.pdf)
. Pricing ranges from $50-$149 per release. If you are interested in larger bulk packages or white labeling, please [contact us](https://www.einpresswire.com/contact)
.

* * *

 How do I purchase press releases?

You’ll need to set up a free account. You can then pay by credit card or PayPal and the press release credits will be immediately applied to your account. If you already have an account and are logged in, please go to the [My Press Releases](https://www.einpresswire.com/press-releases/)
 page and click the link to buy press releases.

If you don’t have an account, please visit our [Pricing and Comparison](https://www.einpresswire.com/pricing)
 page and click the [Get Started](https://www.einpresswire.com/register?plan=presswire-bundled-year&special_offer=OFDYRwHBqSg3KZ9xKjJ6xA%3D%3D)
 button.

* * *

 Are these annual subscriptions?

No. EIN Presswire is a pay-as-you-go service, and we don’t require you to sign an annual contract or maintain a subscription. Use any press release credits within 12 months of the date of purchase. You can use them all immediately if you wish or over time. Simply [buy more credits](https://www.einpresswire.com/pricing)
 when you’re ready.

* * *

 Why are you so much less expensive than some of your competition?

We like to say we get you 90% of where you need to go at 10% of the cost. You are not subsidizing other parts of our business. We have many clients worldwide both large and small just like you.

Some key points:

*   We are a market disruptor with staff in Washington DC, Europe, and Asia, and a 30-year operating history.
*   We are privately held, without large shareholders. Because we retain our independence, we can focus on building the best service for our clients. 
*   Our competition has to pay for distribution that we do not have to. We build our distribution partnerships organically through the intrinsic value we provide, so we don't have to pass exorbitant distribution fees down to our clients.
*   We are not oriented around public market financial disclosures, so we don’t pay for Yahoo Finance, for example. These fees are very expensive and are passed onto clients.
*   We don’t prioritize analytics that are costly to produce and often too easily manipulated. We focus on transparent distribution reporting. See [here](https://www.einpresswire.com/press_releases/representative_report)
     for an example report.

* * *

 How do I pick the best plan for me? What are the differences in service when comparing Basic, Pro+, and Corporate plans?

This depends on how much news you will have to share over the next year. The main differences between our packages are the number of press release credits included (bundling with larger packages allows you to save money per press release) and the number of targets and features you can use. All packages are valid for 365 days after the date of purchase, and all features are per press release credit. Please visit our [Pricing and Comparison](https://www.einpresswire.com/pricing)
 page for more details. 

* * *

 I’ve purchased a Basic release and now I want to upgrade to one of your bundles. Is this possible?

Certainly. Please contact us through the [contact form](https://www.einpresswire.com/contact)
 and we can get you upgraded.

* * *

 When do my press release credits expire?

Press release credits are valid for one year (365 days) from the date of purchase, but can be easily rolled over into a new purchase of the same level or higher for another year. You can check the time remaining for your credits on the [My Press Releases](https://www.einpresswire.com/press-releases/)
 page. To renew your package, simply make your purchase from the [Pricing page](https://www.einpresswire.com/pricing)
.

* * *

 Do I have to pay extra to upload a logo or image to my press release?

We offer simple, transparent pricing options with no surprises. Images are included with all of our releases. Please see our [Pricing and Comparison](https://www.einpresswire.com/pricing)
 page for more information.

* * *

 Where can I find a copy of my payment receipt?

Invoices for your orders can be found on the [My Invoices](https://www.einpresswire.com/account/invoices)
 page.

* * *

 Can my purchase be refunded if I decide not to use your service?

Refunds are available if the package was purchased within the last 60 days and less than 25% of the credits were used. Refunds will be prorated depending on the remaining credits. Please contact us through the [contact form](https://www.einpresswire.com/contact)
 if you wish to discuss a refund.

4. Account
----------

* * *

 How do I get started?

Please visit our [Pricing and Comparison](https://www.einpresswire.com/pricing)
 page and select the option that’s best for you. You can check out our useful [tutorial videos](https://www.einpresswire.com/video-tutorials)
 which walk you through the process.

 I lost my password. How do I retrieve/reset it?

Not a problem. Please go to the [Request New Password](https://www.einpresswire.com/password)
 page and follow the instructions to create a new one.

* * *

 I cannot remember what email address I used to set up my account. How do I find it?

Please first try to find the email we sent you when you signed up. If you do not have one, please email us through our [contact form](https://www.einpresswire.com/contact)
 and provide any information that will help us identify your account, such as the title of a press release you have previously issued through us.

 Can other people on my staff log in to my account?

Yes, they can, but only one email address can be associated with each account. You'll need to share the account log-in credentials with them.

 I see that I can have a Newsroom. What is it?

The [Newsroom](https://www.einpresswire.com/account/newsroom)
 feature is a dedicated page on EIN Presswire, branded with your logo, where all of your press releases will be displayed, along with other information about your company or organization. Newsrooms will have a unique URL that you can refer people to in your marketing materials. It’s also great for your SEO.

Please visit the [My Newsroom Set Up & Use Guide](https://www.einpresswire.com/guide-pdf/EIN-Presswire-My-Newsroom-Set-Up-And-Use-Guide.pdf)
 for further details.

 How do I activate my Newsroom?

You can activate your Newsroom from the [My Newsroom](https://www.einpresswire.com/account/newsroom)
 page. Look for the “activate” link. Please visit the [My Newsroom Set Up & Use Guide](https://www.einpresswire.com/guide-pdf/EIN-Presswire-My-Newsroom-Set-Up-And-Use-Guide.pdf)
 for further details.

 Do all accounts get Newsrooms?

Yes. All accounts can set up a Newsroom. Go to the [My Newsroom](https://www.einpresswire.com/account/newsroom)
 page to get started.
